description: This file defines a comprehensive caching utility class 'UtilCache' providing features like size limiting, expiration, soft references, event listeners, and management of cache instances within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilCache
classes.description: A versatile cache implementation supporting size limits, expiration, soft references, and event notifications; manages cache instances by name within the framework.

methods.name: getOrCreateUtilCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache by name or creates a new one with specified parameters.

methods.name: createUtilCache
methods.description: Creates a new cache with specified configuration options.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all cache instances managed by UtilCache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the cache associated with the provided name.

methods.name: getCacheLineKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of keys currently stored in the cache.

methods.name: getCacheLineValues
methods.description: Returns a collection of cache line objects (unsupported in current implementation).

methods.name: getLineInfos
methods.description: Provides informational maps about cache lines such as key, size, and expiration details.

methods.name: validKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is valid in a specific cache.

methods.name: clearCachesThatStartWith
methods.description: Clears all caches with names beginning with the specified string.

methods.name: findCache
methods.description: Finds and returns a cache instance by name.
